notes: Variant is a standing diagonal cable woodchop. The exact cable woodchop source supports movement specificity, loadability, power, and endurance ratings but not individual muscle roles. External oblique is the strongest primary role from close rotational EMG. Internal oblique is primary from close oblique-task EMG plus the trunk-rotation demand, so this is explicitly a close-evidence inference. Rectus abdominis is secondary as a trunk bracer. Transversus abdominis, quadratus lumborum, and deep hip rotators were not listed because they are not locally mapped as visible muscles in data/anatomy.json.
